ex-0.name: Back squat
technique: Set up with barbell in a stable, comfortable position.
Keep the bar over your midfoot and sit between your hips.
Breathe out through the working phase. Return slowly and reset before the next repetition.
Stop the set when you cannot maintain the same controlled movement.
ex-0.mistakes: Rushing the lowering phase, holding tension in the neck, or continuing after technique deteriorates.
ex-0.cues: Keep the bar over your midfoot and sit between your hips.

ex-1.name: Front squat
technique: Set up with barbell in a stable, comfortable position.
Keep elbows high and maintain an upright torso.
Breathe out through the working phase. Return slowly and reset before the next repetition.
Stop the set when you cannot maintain the same controlled movement.
ex-1.mistakes: Rushing the lowering phase, holding tension in the neck, or continuing after technique deteriorates.
ex-1.cues: Keep elbows high and maintain an upright torso.

ex-2.name: Goblet squat
technique: Set up with dumbbell in a stable, comfortable position.
Hold the bell close to your chest and track knees over toes.
Breathe out through the working phase. Return slowly and reset before the next repetition.
Stop the set when you cannot maintain the same controlled movement.
